app.demoNotice: Chamoli demonstration inputs: population, hazard scores and estimated capacities are fictional planning data. This is not a live warning or a verified shelter register.
app.disclaimer: Follow official instructions. Analysis and news are not evacuation orders. Emergency: 112.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.loginDescription: Sign in to manage your saved locations and safety preferences.
auth.signupDescription: Save locations and personalise your disaster information preferences.
auth.forgotDescription: We will send a secure recovery link to your email.
auth.updateDescription: Your new password is securely handled by Supabase Auth.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Use a unique password.
auth.weakPassword: Choose a password with at least 8 characters.
auth.failed: Authentication failed. Check your details and try again.
auth.invalidLogin: Unable to sign in. Check your email and password, and confirm your email if required.
auth.confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in. If you already have an account, use Sign in or reset your password.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for this email, a recovery link has been sent.
auth.confirmationError: This email link is invalid or has expired. Request a new link or try signing in.
auth.notConfigured: Account services are not configured yet. You can continue as a guest and use the live safety features.
auth.privacy: We save your name, language and optional home region. Precise location is saved only when you explicitly choose to save it.
auth.connectionError: Account services could not be reached. Please try again.
profile.title: Your profile
profile.description: Manage your account, home region and saved locations.
profile.noLocations: No saved locations yet. Choose a location on the dashboard and use Save location.
profile.locationPrivacy: Only you can access these locations. Removing a location deletes it from your account.
profile.storageUnavailable: Your profile could not be loaded. Account storage may need setup, or the connection may be unavailable.
profile.saveFailed: Could not save your changes. Please try again.
profile.removeFailed: Could not remove this saved location.
profile.emailNote: Your email is managed by Supabase Authentication.
settings.title: Settings & privacy
settings.description: Control language, appearance, notifications and location privacy.
settings.notificationConsent: Allow SurakshaSet to notify you about serious disaster warnings near the location you are viewing?
settings.notificationNote: Notifications work while the app is open. Serious alerts are deduplicated. Saved locations are not monitored in the background.
settings.notificationDenied: Notifications are blocked. Change this site's notification permission in your browser settings.
settings.notificationUnsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
settings.notificationGranted: Notification permission granted. Save your preferences to enable serious alert notifications.
settings.notificationEnabled: Notify me about important nearby warnings
settings.guest: Guest preferences are stored on this device. Sign in to save notification preferences to your account.
settings.locationNote: Location access is optional. Choose Use location on the dashboard or search manually. Coordinates stay in the current session unless you explicitly save a location.
settings.permissionDenied: Blocked — you can still search manually
settings.cleared: Device preferences cleared. Your account and saved locations are unchanged.
settings.chatPrivacy: Chat messages are not saved in the database. When you ask the AI, the message and relevant location context are sent to Groq. Use Clear conversation to remove the session chat.
settings.saveAccount: Preferences saved to your account and this device.
